ui.animatedSprite.args: id:string, png:string, xml:string?, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number
ui.animatedSprite.documentation: Create a sprite-sheet widget. The XML path defaults to the PNG basename with `.xml`; the returned widget has animation controls.

parameters.xml: Matching Sparrow XML path; omitted uses the PNG basename.
parameters.x: Horizontal center on the fixed canvas.
parameters.y: Vertical center on the fixed canvas.

ui.button.args: id:string, text:string, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number
ui.button.documentation: Create a button and return its widget table. Its `backgroundColor` and `hoverColor` fields control the fill; define `function button:onClick()` or global `onClick(id)` for interaction.

parameters.x: Horizontal center; 0–1 is proportional to the 1280-pixel canvas.
parameters.y: Vertical center; 0–1 is proportional to the 720-pixel canvas.

ui.clear.documentation: Remove all widgets, animated states, and active widget tweens from this menu screen.

ui.get.documentation: Get an existing widget by ID.

ui.gradient.args: tag:string, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number, type:string?, colors:table?, angle:number?
ui.gradient.documentation: Create an independent gradient object; it can also be used as a mask source.

parameters.colors: Table of 2–16 color stops; entries can contain `at`, `color`, and `alpha`.

ui.graph.args: id:string, shape:string?, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number, color:string?
ui.graph.documentation: Create a colored graph widget. If shape is omitted, geometry begins immediately after the ID and the shape defaults to rectangle.

ui.graphic.args: id:string, shape:string?, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number, color:string?
ui.graphic.documentation: Create a colored graph widget. If shape is omitted, geometry begins immediately after the ID and the shape defaults to rectangle.

ui.image.args: id:string, image:string, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number
ui.image.documentation: Create a static image widget. The image path is resolved from the current mod/assets roots. Use `ui.world` to move it into 3D space.

parameters.image: Relative image asset path, such as `images/cover.png`.

ui.label.args: id:string, text:string, x:number, y:number, width:number?, height:number?
ui.label.documentation: Create a text label and return its widget table. Set its font, shadow, alignment, border, scale, and order on the table or through text helper functions.

parameters.x: Horizontal center; 0–1 is proportional to the fixed 1280-pixel canvas.
parameters.y: Vertical center; 0–1 is proportional to the fixed 720-pixel canvas.
parameters.width: Optional wrapping width; zero uses text size.

ui.panel.args: id:string, text:string, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number
ui.panel.documentation: Create a background panel. The text argument is retained for the shared constructor layout but is not rendered on a panel.

parameters.text: Unused panel text slot; pass an empty string.

ui.slider.args: id:string, text:string, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number
ui.slider.documentation: Create a slider widget. Configure the returned table’s `min`, `max`, and `value` fields; defaults are 0, 1, and 0.

ui.sprite.args: id:string, image:string, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number
ui.sprite.documentation: Create a static sprite widget with the same geometry as `ui.image`.

ui.toggle.args: id:string, text:string, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number
ui.toggle.documentation: Create a toggle widget and return its table. Its `value` field starts false and changes when clicked.

ui.world.documentation: Move a widget into 3D space using block offsets from the current machine origin. Returns the same widget.

parameters.widget: Widget table returned by a `ui` constructor, or its ID.

ui.worldAbsolute.documentation: Move a widget to an absolute Minecraft world position, independent of machine facing/location.

parameters.widget: Widget table returned by a `ui` constructor, or its ID.

machine.close.documentation: Close the custom menu and save machine data.

machine.exitWorld.documentation: Leave the Minecraft world immediately, without an extra custom-menu prompt.

machine.getScreen.documentation: Return the name of the current menu screen.

machine.getScreens.documentation: Return names of available scripts in this machine’s screens folder.

machine.getSong.documentation: Return one song-data table or nil if the ID is unavailable.

machine.getSongExitTarget.documentation: Read the current song-exit destination (`menu`, `world`, or `selector`).

machine.getSongs.documentation: Return a Lua array of available songs. Each song has an ID, display name, opponent icon, and difficulties.

machine.getWeek.documentation: Return one week-data table or nil if the week is unavailable.

machine.getWeeks.documentation: Return a Lua array of available week-data tables.

machine.hasSong.documentation: Check whether a song is available.

machine.hasWeek.documentation: Check whether a week is available.

parameters.returnTo: Where quitting/finishing should go after the selected song.

machine.openCharacterEditor.documentation: Open Blockified’s character editor and save machine data first.

machine.openChartEditor.documentation: Open the chart editor, optionally preselecting a song and difficulty.

parameters.song: Song ID; blank or omitted lets the editor choose.

machine.openScreen.documentation: Open a second Lua screen from this machine’s `screens/<name>.lua` folder.

machine.openSongDetails.documentation: Open built-in details for an available song.

parameters.returnTo: Where quitting/finishing should go after the selected song.

machine.playSong.documentation: Start a song directly. Use `options.machine` to select a hitbox-less virtual machine by tag; `options.returnTo = "menu"` returns to its menu after the song. The other options include `duet`, `playAs`, and `look`.

parameters.song: Song ID from the current available songs.
parameters.difficulty: Difficulty name; omitted uses the song default.

machine.setSongExitTarget.documentation: Change where a song returns after finishing or quitting.

camera.getFOV.documentation: Read the custom menu camera’s field of view in degrees.

camera.getPitch.documentation: Read the custom menu camera’s pitch.

camera.getRoll.documentation: Read the custom menu camera’s roll.

camera.getX.documentation: Read the custom menu camera’s world X position.

camera.getY.documentation: Read the custom menu camera’s world Y position.

camera.getYaw.documentation: Read the custom menu camera’s yaw.

camera.getZ.documentation: Read the custom menu camera’s world Z position.

camera.getZoom.documentation: Read the custom menu camera’s zoom.

camera.lookAt.documentation: Point the menu camera at world coordinates.

camera.reset.documentation: Reset the custom machine-menu camera to its original position, rotation, zoom, and FOV.

camera.setFOV.documentation: Set field of view, independently of the camera zoom property.

camera.setPosition.documentation: Set the machine-menu camera position in Minecraft coordinates. This opts into the custom menu camera behavior.

camera.setRotation.documentation: Set the menu camera orientation immediately.

addToGroup.documentation: Put a widget into a compositing group, which controls its combined rendering.

cancelTween.documentation: Cancel a widget, camera, or blur tween by tag.

debugPrint.documentation: Show a temporary debug line above the menu and write it to the log. The optional color accepts a hex/name string or an integer color value.

parameters.color: Optional text color; defaults to white.

disableMenuBlur.documentation: Set the current menu’s background blur to zero.

doTweenAlpha.documentation: Tween a widget’s opacity. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenAngle.documentation: Tween a widget’s 2D angle. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenCamRotationX.documentation: Tween the menu camera’s pitch; completion calls onTweenCompleted(tag).

doTweenCamRotationY.documentation: Tween the menu camera’s yaw; completion calls onTweenCompleted(tag).

doTweenCamRotationZ.documentation: Tween the menu camera’s roll; completion calls onTweenCompleted(tag).

doTweenCamX.documentation: Tween the menu camera’s world X position; completion calls onTweenCompleted(tag).

doTweenCamY.documentation: Tween the menu camera’s world Y position; completion calls onTweenCompleted(tag).

doTweenCamZ.documentation: Tween the menu camera’s world Z position; completion calls onTweenCompleted(tag).

doTweenCamZoom.documentation: Tween the menu camera’s zoom; completion calls onTweenCompleted(tag).

doTweenColor.documentation: Tween a widget’s color from its current value to a hex color.

parameters.color: Target hex color or packed RGB number.

doTweenEffect.args: tag:string, target:string, property:string, amount:number, duration:number, easing:string?
doTweenEffect.documentation: Tween a numeric gradient, mask, or clip effect property.

parameters.property: Numeric effect field such as `maskX`, `gradientAngle`, or `clipWidth`.

doTweenFontScale.documentation: Tween a widget’s font scale. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenHeight.documentation: Tween a widget’s height. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenMenuBlur.documentation: Tween the current menu blur radius. The tween controls blur until resetMenuBlur is called.

doTweenRotationX.documentation: Tween a widget’s 3D X rotation. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenRotationY.documentation: Tween a widget’s 3D Y rotation. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenText.args: tag:string, target:string, amount:number, duration:number, easing:string, property:string
doTweenText.documentation: Tween supported menu text properties, including line spacing, letter spacing, border size, and font scale.

doTweenWidth.documentation: Tween a widget’s width. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenX.documentation: Tween a widget’s X position. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenY.documentation: Tween a widget’s Y position. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

doTweenZ.documentation: Tween a widget’s world Z position. The completion callback receives the tween tag.

enableMenuBlur.documentation: Enable menu-background blur; omitted uses the configured blur radius or at least 1.

getFOV.documentation: Get menu camera field of view.

getHoveredObject.documentation: Return the topmost visible widget ID beneath the cursor, or an empty string.

getMenuBlur.documentation: Read the active blur radius, or the user’s configured radius when this menu is not overriding it.

getMouseX.documentation: Get mouse X on the fixed menu canvas.

getMouseY.documentation: Get mouse Y on the fixed menu canvas.

getObjectParent.documentation: Get the current parent widget ID.

getSoundPitch.documentation: Read a tagged menu sound’s pitch multiplier.

getSoundTime.documentation: Read a tagged menu sound’s time in milliseconds.

getSoundVolume.documentation: Read a tagged menu sound’s volume level.

getTextFontMode.documentation: Read the selected rendering mode of a menu text widget.

getTextQuality.documentation: Get the current font oversampling factor of a menu text widget.

getTextString.documentation: Read the current text of a label or button.

isMouseDown.documentation: Check whether a mouse button is held. Defaults to the left button.

keyboardJustPressed.documentation: True on the first frame of a key press.

keyboardPressed.documentation: True while the key is held.

keyboardReleased.documentation: True when the key is released.

makeLuaGradient.args: tag:string, x:number, y:number, width:number, height:number, type:string?, colors:table?, angle:number?
makeLuaGradient.documentation: Create an independent gradient object; it can also be used as a mask source.

parameters.colors: Table of 2–16 color stops; entries can contain `at`, `color`, and `alpha`.

mouseInside.documentation: Test whether the cursor is inside a rectangle centered at X/Y on the fixed menu canvas.

mouseOver.documentation: Test whether the cursor is over a visible widget, including 3D widgets.

playSound.documentation: Play a menu sound. An empty tag creates a fire-and-forget sound; tagged sounds can later be paused, stopped, or adjusted.

parameters.tag: Sound instance ID, or empty string for fire-and-forget.
parameters.loop: True repeats until stopped; default false.

precacheSound.documentation: Pre-decode audio to avoid a pause when playback begins.

removeFromGroup.documentation: Remove a widget from its compositing group.

removeObjectGradient.documentation: Disable the gradient on a widget without deleting the widget.

removeObjectMask.documentation: Clear the mask assigned to a widget.

removeObjectParent.documentation: Detach a widget from its parent. The default retains the child’s world transform.

parameters.keepPosition: True preserves world position; default true.

resetMenuBlur.documentation: Stop overriding blur and return to the player’s configured menu blur.

runTimer.documentation: Start a menu timer; completion calls `onTimerCompleted`.

setBlendMode.documentation: Change how this object blends with pixels behind it.

setFOV.documentation: Set menu camera field of view.

setMenuBlur.documentation: Take control of Minecraft’s menu-background blur for this menu. Values below 1 disable it.

setObjectClip.args: id:string, type:string, x:number?, y:number?, width:number?, height:number?, radius:number?, softness:number?
setObjectClip.documentation: Clip a widget locally to a rectangle, circle, or rounded shape.

parameters.x: Clip center X in local coordinates.
parameters.y: Clip center Y in local coordinates.

setObjectGradient.documentation: Apply a local-space gradient to an existing object.

parameters.colors: Table of 2–16 stops; each stop may have `at`, `color`, and `alpha`.

setObjectMask.documentation: Mask one menu widget with another. This changes visibility, not transforms; parenting is separate.

parameters.maskOnly: Hide the source outside masking; defaults to true.

setObjectOrder.documentation: Set widget layer order; larger values draw later.

setObjectParent.documentation: Attach a widget to another; by default the child’s local position resets to 0,0,0.

parameters.keepPosition: True keeps the child’s world transform.

setObjectRenderMode.documentation: Choose 3D rendering behavior for a menu widget.

setObjectShaderMode.documentation: Choose 3D rendering behavior for a menu widget.

setSoundPitch.documentation: Change pitch of a tagged menu sound.

setSoundTime.documentation: Seek a tagged menu sound to a time in milliseconds.

setSoundVolume.documentation: Change volume of a tagged menu sound.

setTextBorder.documentation: Draw an outline/border around menu text.

parameters.color: Hex color or packed RGB number.

setTextFont.documentation: Use a font asset resolved from the current mod’s font roots.

setTextFontMode.documentation: Choose smooth or pixel rendering for a menu text widget.

setTextItalic.documentation: Toggle italic styling for menu text.

setTextLetterSpacing.documentation: Set extra space between letters for menu text.

setTextLineSpacing.documentation: Set extra line spacing for menu text.

setTextQuality.documentation: Change font oversampling for a menu label/button.

setTextShadow.documentation: Show or hide the Minecraft-style shadow behind menu text.

parameters.enabled: True shows shadow; false hides it.

setTextSize.documentation: Set text size in pixels relative to the 16-pixel Lua baseline.

parameters.pixels: Desired text size in menu canvas pixels.

setTextString.documentation: Change the text displayed by a label or button.

setWorldSpriteLighting.documentation: Enable or disable world lighting for a 3D menu widget and restore its render mode to auto.

parameters.enabled: True respects world lighting; false uses flat rendering.

setWorldSpriteRenderMode.documentation: Choose 3D rendering behavior for a menu widget.

soundExists.documentation: Check whether a tagged menu sound exists.

onOpen.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onClose.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onUpdate.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onTimerCompleted.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onTweenCompleted.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onSoundFinished.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onMouseDown.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onMouseUp.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onClick.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onHover.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onHoverExit.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onKeyPress.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onKeyRelease.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

onScroll.documentation: Machine-menu callback. Widget methods such as `function play:onClick()` can be used where applicable.

screenWidth.documentation: Fixed menu canvas width (1280), independent of Minecraft window size.

screenHeight.documentation: Fixed menu canvas height (720), independent of Minecraft window size.

machineData.documentation: Persistent data table for the current machine.

machine.id.documentation: ID/tag of the current virtual or physical machine.
